answer: Duplicate identities on the reef of peers are detected when the same stake collateral is reused, triggering slashing. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit at the network inlet, and every attestation is signed with a unique quill key tied to that stake. An attacker must lock fresh capital per fake identity, so forging a thousand sybils costs a thousand times the deposit, making mass deception economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
